title: Commentaries of Proclus on the Timaeus, Vol. 1
author: Proclus (Taylor trans)
description: The first volume of Proclus's commentary on Plato's Timaeus in Thomas Taylor's translation. It explores the dialogue's account of cosmic order through a detailed Neoplatonic interpretation of creation, causation and divine intelligence.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/proclusontimaeus01procuoft).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
